description: Database-specific procedure and function call test fixtures for Neo4j (APOC/Vector), Memgraph (MAGE), and DuckDB (DuckPGQ/Parquet).

test_cases.description: Call APOC procedure for path expansion with label filtering
test_cases.expected_query:
MATCH (start:Person {id: $p0})
CALL apoc.path.subgraphNodes(start, {maxLevel: 3, relationshipFilter: 'KNOWS>'}) YIELD node
RETURN node.name AS reachable_name

test_cases.description: Neo4j Vector Index approximate nearest neighbor search (ANN)
test_cases.expected_query:
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('user_embeddings', $p0, $p1) YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS id, node.name AS name, score
ORDER BY score DESC

CALL pagerank.get() YIELD node, rank
RETURN node.name AS user_name, rank
ORDER BY rank DESC
LIMIT $p0

test_cases.description: DuckPGQ property graph querying directly over Parquet files
test_cases.expected_query:
SELECT gt.a_name, gt.b_name
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  parquet_graph
  MATCH (a:Person) -[k:knows]-> (b:Person)
  COLUMNS (a.name AS a_name, b.name AS b_name)
) AS gt
